# BirthdayGen

> BirthdayGen (https://birthday.nirbhay.online) is a **free, no-signup web tool** that turns a name, message, and some photos into a full interactive birthday website — shareable on WhatsApp in one tap. No app download. No account. Ready in under 30 seconds.

For the full technical documentation and complete content directory, see [llms-full.txt](https://birthday.nirbhay.online/llms-full.txt).

---

## What BirthdayGen Does

BirthdayGen generates a unique URL (`/b/[id]`) that opens as a cinematic birthday experience:
1. **Gift reveal** — recipient taps an animated gift box that bursts open with confetti
2. **Virtual candle blowing** — microphone detects real blowing/breath and extinguishes candle flames in real time
3. **Photo gallery** — scrollable slideshow of personal photos the sender uploads
4. **Custom message** — the heartfelt text the sender writes, styled per the chosen theme
5. **Ambient music** — background audio from Classic Happy Birthday, Music Box, or Party Pop

## 8 Visual Themes

1. **Royal Gold** — dark luxury, deep purple, metallic gold
2. **Midnight Stars** — cosmic navy, starlight animations
3. **Princess Fairytale** — soft pastel pinks, romantic elegance
4. **Unicorn Kids** — vibrant purple and rainbow, great for children
5. **Fun & Colorful** — cheerful magenta, multicolor confetti
6. **Elegant Classic** — warm ivory, timeless serif typography
7. **Retro Neon Arcade** — cyberpunk terminal green, dark contrast
8. **Modern Minimal** — clean monochrome, typography-first

---

## Pricing Summary

- **Free tier**: Create, personalize, preview and share interactive birthday websites — always free, no watermarks, no paywalls
- **Premium**: Multi-act cinematic experiences, wax-sealed letter reveal, anniversary mode — starts at **₹49** (~$0.60 USD)
- **No subscription**: One-time purchase per premium experience

---

## Supported Platforms

Works in any modern browser on: iOS (Safari, Chrome), Android (Chrome, Samsung Internet), macOS (Safari, Chrome, Firefox), Windows (Chrome, Edge, Firefox). No app download required.

---

## Privacy & Data

- No account registration required — ever
- Uploaded photos are stored only to render the birthday page for the recipient
- Individual greeting pages (`/b/[id]`) are `noindex` — personal data never surfaces in search results
- Pages auto-expire after 30 days (renewable free)
- No third-party ad tracking, no data selling
